San Jose to Seattle

Arrive Shanghai Pudong (PVG)

Use the 240-hour transit lane at immigration. Have your passport, Seoul ticket (Nov 24), hotel booking and the arrival card ready. The stay clock starts at 00:00 the day after you enter, so leaving Nov 24 is well inside the limit. Expect it to take longer than a normal arrival, so be near the front of the plane if you can.

🚗
~1 hr · Didi or taxi to the Bund area (my estimate, not verified)
~10:30pmNailsBookedHands and feet

Nail appointment near the Bund (booked for 9:00 PM)

Your booking is for 9:00 PM, but you land at 7:55 PM. Even with a fast immigration line, you reach the Bund around 10:15 to 11 PM at the earliest. Message the salon today, or from Seattle, to move the start to about 11 PM and ask if they stay open that late. Doing hands and feet together with two technicians should take about 2 hours. If they cannot push it, I put a fallback morning slot on Nov 17. Go straight from the airport with your bags if the salon allows it.

10:00amJewelryCustom

Yuyuan: custom gold and jewelry

The Yuyuan area has Zijincheng, a gold and jewelry trading center with custom studios. Reports say foreign visitors often order here, with material plus labor pricing. Typical custom orders take about two weeks, which is longer than you are in town, so ask for a rush or a pickup on Monday afternoon. Other options: VETIVER (757 Renmin Rd, Huangpu, showroom by appointment) and Cunjin Dian. I picked these from news and blog posts, not independent reviews. I could not find a reliable custom studio in Chongqing, and the turnaround would not fit anyway.

Mall: Chinese designer fashion

Best fit is HKRI Taikoo Hui on Nanjing West Road, close to your hotel and good for independent designers. Xintiandi is good for local labels, and iAPM for modern Chinese brands. Plaza 66 is mostly international luxury. Check store lineups before you go.

9:30pmSpa24 hr~¥300 base

Overnight at a 24 hour spa: Yang-SPACE

Near Lujiazui at 57 Pudian Rd, listed as open 24/7 with sleep pods and an unlimited fruit and ice cream bar. One guide lists a base ticket of about ¥299, with meals and massage extra. Overnight stays can add a surcharge (reported ¥30 to 69), and policies differ by venue, so ask at the desk. Bring your passport, a power bank, earplugs and an eye mask. Your friend can stay 12 hours, 9:30 PM to 9:30 AM. Tell the front desk if you want a longer stay. Two other options from your friend's guide are Dong Fang Quan Du (natural springs) and Lian Quan Da Jiang Hu (Japanese style). I could not verify those two. You will not use your hotel bed tonight.

Before You Go

Good to Know

Entry rules, money, phones and safety.

🛂

China entry: 240-hour transit

  • US passports are on the list. Your Seoul flight is the required onward leg.
  • Passport needs at least 3 months of validity and no Chinese visa refusal stamps.
  • The clock starts at 00:00 the day after you enter. You leave Nov 24, about 7.5 days after landing.
  • Shanghai and Chongqing are on the list of permitted areas according to sources, but sources disagree on regional detail. Confirm with Delta at check-in.
  • Carry hotel bookings for every night. The official page does not require them but guides say to show them.
💳

Money and phone

  • Alipay and WeChat Pay accept foreign Visa, Mastercard and Amex. Set up Alipay before you fly and keep some cash.
  • A travel eSIM that routes data outside China makes Google and WhatsApp work. Install it before you fly.
  • Apple Maps and Amap work better than Google Maps in China. Download offline maps.
🧳

Spring Airlines bags

Both Spring flights (Nov 17 and Nov 20) are strict. Carry-on is usually 7 kg and basic fares may include no checked bag. Weigh your bag and check your ticket.

🇰🇷

South Korea entry

  • K-ETA is waived for US citizens through Dec 31, 2026.
  • You still file the free e-Arrival Card.
  • A Seoul address is needed. Hotel is not booked yet.
🌡

Weather

I could not confirm November forecasts. Chongqing can be foggy, Seoul can be cold. Check the forecast the day before and bring layers.

⚠

Local rules

  • Carry your original passport. Hotels and train stations check it.
  • For the Suzhou trains, bring the passport you booked with.
  • Cell data may be patchy in the mountains around Dazu.
📞

Emergency numbers

  • China: police 110, fire 119, ambulance 120
  • South Korea: police 112, fire and ambulance 119, Korea Travel Helpline 1330
  • US: contact the nearest US embassy or consulate
❓
